title: Large Language Bayes Is Not Reparameterisation-Invariant
abstract: arXiv:2610.00265v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Bayes (LLB) answers an informal modelling question by sampling candidate probabilistic programs from a language model, running approximate inference on each, and averaging them with weights proportional to an exponentiated evidence bound. We show that this weighting depends on how a model is written. The log marginal likelihood is invariant to reparameterisation; the evidence bound is not. On eight schools the centered and non-centered programs are the same measure to $5.7\times10^{-14}$, yet their weights differ by $6.1\times$; importance weighting reduces this only to $2.2\times$, and reproducing the inference LLB actually runs, a full-covariance Gaussian matched to the posterior moments, still leaves $1.9\times$ on eight schools and $8.9\times$ in $64$ dimensions. translated_title: 大语言贝叶斯不具备重参数化不变性
translated_abstract: 大语言贝叶斯（LLB）通过从语言模型中采样候选概率程序、对每个程序运行近似推断、并以与指数化证据界限成比例的权重对它们进行平均，来回答非正式的建模问题。我们证明这种加权方式依赖于模型的书写形式。对数边际似然对重参数化是不变的，而证据界限则不是。在“八所学校”数据集上，中心化与非中心化程序在5.7×10⁻¹⁴的精度下是同一测度，但它们的权重却相差6.1倍；重要性加权仅能将该差距缩小至2.2倍；而复现LLB实际运行的推断方式——与后验矩匹配的全协方差高斯——仍然在八所学校上留下1.9倍的差异，在64维情形下留下8.9倍的差异。跨似然函数族、维度以及漏斗形后验的严重程度，该差异最高可达31.9倍且会改变符号，因此不存在一种在所有情况下都更优的单一书写方式。
tldr: 该论文揭示了大语言贝叶斯（LLB）中基于指数化证据界限的模型加权不具备重参数化不变性——数学上完全相同的模型因书写方式不同会获得相差最高31.9倍的权重，而真正不变的对数边际似然应被采用。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that Large Language Bayes' weighting scheme based on an exponentiated evidence bound is not reparameterisation-invariant—mathematically identical programs written differently receive weights differing by up to 31.9×—whereas the log marginal likelihood remains invariant.
